strings.save.error.title: Save could not be read
strings.save.error.advice: The game started a new run. The old file was not deleted.

strings.objective.get_bearings: Get your bearings. The lesson has not started.
strings.objective.check_bag: Find your biology textbook. Check your bag.
strings.objective.outside: You are outside. Nothing asks you to be anywhere.
strings.objective.residential: The road goes on towards the flats.
strings.objective.animal: Something green is standing on the concrete.
strings.overlay.expect_body: Nothing in this has happened. It is what you imagine.
strings.overlay.deny_body: The bell has not rung. Nobody has come in.
strings.objective.bell: Second bell. The lesson is starting.
strings.objective.no_textbook: No textbook. Look around before the second bell. You can glance at the corridor if you like.
strings.end.slice.title: End of this build
strings.end.slice.body: You are past the school, through the flats, and out in the open yard behind them: a court, a shed, a climbing frame, a bench. The gap in the fence at the far end is the next thing to build.
strings.objective.alley: The alley runs behind the flats. There is a gate at the end of it.
strings.objective.playground: The yard is open. Nothing here is a task.
strings.prompt.gate_far: Go through the gap in the fence
strings.objective.free_period: N says you can study here or spend the period in the yard. It's up to you.
strings.objective.stay_classroom: You've decided to stay in the classroom.
strings.objective.schoolyard: The yard is through the door at the end of the walkway.
strings.prompt.yard_to_corridor: Go back in through the fire door
strings.menu.title: Title screen
strings.menu.save_unreadable: The save file could not be read, so there is nothing to continue. The file has not been deleted.
strings.menu.confirm_new_game: Your current progress and its save will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
strings.menu.confirm_new_game_broken: The unreadable save will be removed; the copy that was set aside is kept.
strings.menu.confirm_quit_checkpoint: You are in the middle of a conversation or a scene, so the game cannot save right now. If you quit, you will continue from the last save: {caption}.
strings.menu.confirm_quit_no_save: The game cannot save right now, and nothing has been saved yet. If you quit, the next game starts from the beginning.
strings.menu.confirm_quit_failed: The game could not be saved: {detail}. The last save is not affected.
strings.menu.new_game_failed.save_stage_failed: The new game did not start: the save file could not be moved aside.
strings.menu.new_game_failed.scene_change_failed: The new game did not start: the opening could not be loaded.
strings.menu.new_game_failed.staged_discard_fail: The new game did not start: the old save could not be removed.
strings.menu.new_game_failed.state_left: The new game did not start: the last run could not be cleared.
strings.menu.new_game_failed.unknown: The new game did not start.
strings.menu.new_game_failed.busy: A new game is already starting. Wait a moment, then try again.
strings.menu.new_game_failed.kept: Nothing was lost: your save and your progress are as they were.
strings.menu.new_game_failed.save_lost: The old save could not be put back. A copy is at {path}.
